rationale: Substantival form on the root ⲥⲟⲩⲧⲱⲛ 'be straight, extended.' Designates the ordered linear-extensive structure of the cosmos to which Adam's soul-molding is conformed. Distinct from the verbal qualitative ⲥⲟⲩⲧⲁⲛⲧ in the same line.

Plural noun in zodiac/stars/X/years sequence at K.157.24. Likely a temporal or spatial subdivision-term ('divisions of the days'). Etymology unclear; may be Lyc. variant of ⲛⲉⲩ 'time/hour' pluralized, or a Greek-derived enumerative term. Confidence low; flagged for parallel attestations.

proposed_english: to take precedence / take possession in advance
rationale: Lycopolitan ⲭ for ϫ on ϫⲓ ('take, receive') + ⲟⲩⲱ ('already, in advance') — Crum 752a registers ϫⲓ-ⲟⲩⲱ as 'be first in something, take precedence.' Used twice on this page (lines 31, 34) of the bitter powers/archons aiming to take pre-eminence over Adam's kingship.

Possessed feminine noun ⲧⲉϩ- 'his' + ⲥⲁⲓϣ. Context (placed within Adam alongside the cosmic powers arranged as zodiacal houses) supports an astrological-allotment sense. May be related to ⲥⲁⲡ 'time, lot, portion' in glossary, or a separate noun for 'measure/share.' Confidence low; flag for parallels.

Recurring Lycopolitan existential predicate (lines 5, 10, 14). The form ⲁⲩⲟ̄ⲛ functions as 'exists/is'; with object suffix -ⲧϩ̄ it becomes possessive 'there is to him / he has.' Apparently a fused form of ⲟⲩⲛ- + qualitative element + suffix; warrants further morphological investigation across the corpus.
